name: cost-band
description: Status line with session $ and cache ratio ("$12.34 · cache 87%"), always on; above the prompt an amber band from the nudge cost (default $15) saying to start a new session, red at the limit (default $20), and one toast at each. Refreshes after each turn and every 60 s. At the handoff cap (default $20) it submits one prompt asking Claude to write a handoff and offer a fresh chat (auto_handoff=false turns that off).

limit_usd.title: Session cost limit (USD)
limit_usd.description: The band turns red at this cost. If the nudge is not below it, amber starts at 80% of this.

nudge_usd.title: Start-a-new-session nudge (USD)
nudge_usd.description: From this cost the band turns amber and says to start a new session; a toast fires once here and once at the limit.

handoff_usd.title: Auto-handoff cap (USD)
handoff_usd.description: On the first finished turn at or over this cost, a prompt asks Claude to write a handoff and offer a fresh chat. 0 or less disables.

auto_handoff.title: Auto-handoff at the cap
auto_handoff.description: Set false to keep only the bands and toasts and never submit the handoff prompt.
